subject: Swamps
text: Walking on swamps inflicts two hitpoints of damage each time unless wearing Erdrick's Armor.

evidence.quote: Each time you walk on them you will lose two hitpoints. Once you get Erdrick's Armor, swamps won't hurt you at all.

subject: Barriers
text: Stepping on a barrier tile deals 15 hitpoints of damage unless protected by Erdrick's Armor.

evidence.quote: Everytime you walk on one, you will lose 15 hitpoints. Like swamps, you don't lose any damage from them if you have Erdrick's Armor.

subject: Erdrick's Cave
text: Erdrick's Tablet is found inside Erdrick's Cave located just north of Tantagel Castle.

evidence.quote: Erdrick's Cave - Just north of Tantagel Castle. Here you will find the Erdrick's Tablet.

subject: Mountain Cave
text: The death necklace can be obtained in the Mountain Cave southeast of Garinham.

evidence.quote: Mountain Cave - Southeast of Garninham.  This the first cave you will explore that has enemies. Get the death necklace and fighter's ring here.

subject: Mountain Cave
text: The fighter's ring is found in the Mountain Cave southeast of Garinham.

evidence.quote: Mountain Cave - Southeast of Garninham.  This the first cave you will explore that has enemies. Get the death necklace and fighter's ring here.

subject: Green Dragon
text: A Green Dragon guards the princess in Swamp Cave and must be fought to rescue her.

evidence.quote: One is, that is where you will have to go to rescue the princess... You will have to fight a Green Dragon in order to rescue her and you will also need a magic key.

subject: Swamp Cave
text: To navigate through Swamp Cave to Rimuldar without light, walk down to the wall sound, right to the sound, down, right, down, left, and up the stairs.

evidence.quote: To get to Rimildar you won't need a torch or radiant. It is very easy to find your way out of the cave. Just go down for a long way until you hear a thumping sound. Then go to the right until you hear the same sound. Then down again, right, down, and finally left. Then go up the stairs and you will be out of the swamp.

subject: Grave of Garinham
text: The silver harp is located inside the Grave of Garinham, which requires a key in town and another key inside.

evidence.quote: Grave of Garninham - Use a key in the town of Garninham to reach here. You will also need another key when you get inside the grave. The silver harp is here as well as many strong enemies.

subject: Tantegel Castle
text: Speaking to the man in the southeastern corner of Tantegel Castle restores all MP once the Heal spell is learned.

evidence.quote: Once you get the heal spell, talk to the man in the southeastern corner of Tantegel Castle to regain MP. You never have to use an Inn again!

subject: Throne Room Chest
text: The treasure chests in the King's throne room contain 120 gold, a torch, and a magic key.

evidence.quote: In the chests you will find 120 gold, a torch and a magic key.

subject: Level 2
text: Level 2 is reached after accumulating 7 experience points.

evidence.quote: Keep doing this until you reach level 2 which will be after 7 experience points.

subject: Level 3
text: Level 3 is reached at 23 experience points, granting the Heal spell and 5 MP.

evidence.quote: You will reach level 3 when you have 23 experience points. Now you will also have the spell of heal. You also have 5 MP. Heal costs 4 MP so you can only use it once in this level.

subject: Leather Armor
text: Leather armor can be purchased in Breconary for 70 gold, and starting clothes sell for 10 gold.

evidence.quote: When you have 70, go to Breconary, buy the leather armor for 70 and sell the clothes for 10.

subject: Level 4
text: Reaching level 4 requires accumulating 47 experience points.

evidence.quote: When you leave the castle again, go back to where you were fighting and fight until you have 47 experience points and make it to level 4.

subject: Garinham Inn
text: Staying at the inn in Garinham costs 25 gold.

evidence.quote: When you run low on energy and need to go to the inn now, still go to Breconary because the inn in Garninham costs 25 gold.

subject: Small Shield
text: The small shield costs 90 gold to purchase.

evidence.quote: Keep fighting and collecting gold until you get 90 gold which is when you will buy the small shield.

subject: Level 5
text: Attaining level 5 requires earning 110 experience points.

evidence.quote: When you get 110 experience points, you will be in level 5.

subject: Kol Inn
text: Resting at the inn in Kol costs 20 gold.

evidence.quote: When you run low on energy, stop into to Kol and rest at the inn for 20 gold which won't be too bad at this point since you are making a lot more gold.

subject: Kol Bath
text: Searching three steps directly south of the bath in Kol reveals the Fairy Flute.

evidence.quote: While you are in Kol, go to the northern part of town where there is a bath that supposedly cures Rheumatism.
Walk directly underneath and take tree steps down and search and you will find the Fairy Flute.

subject: Copper Sword
text: The Copper Sword costs 180 gold to buy in Breconary, while the club sells for 30 gold.

evidence.quote: When you have 180 gold, go back to Breconary, buy the Copper Sword, sell your club for 30, go to the inn for 6 and go back to the castle and save, then go back to the Kol area.

subject: Chain Mail
text: Chain mail costs 300 gold to purchase in Garinham.

evidence.quote: You have to fight a lot of magidrakees and scorpions to get to level 7 and you also need to save 300 for the chain mail. When you finally get enough for the chain mail, go to Garninham and buy it

subject: Mountain Cave Bottom Floor Chest
text: A chest on the bottom floor of the Mountain Cave contains between 100 and 130 gold or the death necklace.

evidence.quote: go to the mountain cave and go to the bottom floor... Find the chest that has 100-130 gold. Take it.

subject: Death Necklace
text: The death necklace sells for 1200 gold at the tool shop in Kol.

evidence.quote: When you finally get the death necklace, go to Kol, and go to the tool shop there ad sell the death necklace for 1200 gold.

subject: Hand Axe
text: The Hand Axe can be bought at the weapons shop in Kol for 560 gold, and the Copper Sword sells for 90 gold.

evidence.quote: Then go to the weapons shop and buy the Hand Axe for 560 gold and sell your Copper Sword for 90 gold.

subject: Half Plate
text: Half Plate armor can be purchased in Garinham for 1000 gold.

evidence.quote: When you have gone enough times to have 1000 gold, go to Garninham, buy the Half Plate, save your game and go back to Kol for just a little while and fight until you reach level 9.

subject: Broad Sword
text: The Broad Sword costs 1500 gold in Rimuldar.

evidence.quote: Fight them until you get enough gold to buy the Broad Sword for 1500 gold.

subject: Key Shop
text: Magic keys can be purchased from the key shop found along the outside northern perimeter of Rimuldar.

evidence.quote: Then go to the key shop by walking along the outside of the northern part of town and buy 6 magic keys to last you a long time.
